title: Chapter 71 Combat Orders
content:
Chapter 71 Combat Orders

The return journey was smooth. The Alliance army, which had gone out to rob, returned safely to the territory where the Bull Tribe was stationed before dark.

The Alliance elite, who had let off their anger, became morale-boosting again.

With supplies, the Alliance army did not save them, and even gave some food to the Zerg.

Some things that were not used or wanted were given to the Bull Tribe to continue to bring the two sides closer.

The Bull Tribe was a noble person who was willing to help the Alliance army when it was in trouble, and it was worth making friends with the Alliance.

Although it didn't matter to the Zerg whether there was help from the Bull Tribe, no matter which world it was in, more friends meant more paths.

If you have the opportunity to make friends, you have to make more friends. With more friends, there will always be unexpected gains.

The control of the territory where the Bull Tribe was stationed was still in the hands of the Tengu Tribe, and there was no way to adjust the lord protection area of the territory. When the sun set, the lord protection weakened area outside the city, and all kinds of strange things began to appear.

The Zerg army, which had just eaten and was full of energy, began the popular activity of fighting weirdness under the leadership of the host.

In the relatively distant Daxia Territory and Zerg Territory, the Zerg troops left behind were also carrying out the same activities.

Every day, the weak weirdness in the weakened area of the lord's shelter was cleared, and the weirdness in the wild was deliberately attracted to gather at the edge of the territory for extermination, which could increase the system's resource income.

Therefore, no matter where they went, fighting weirdness became a daily activity of the Zerg.

The movement outside the city made Niu Kun feel a little sorry, and he ran to find Meng and asked if he needed help.

After politely rejecting Niu Kun, Meng pulled Niu Kun to sit down, called Wu Qing, Yu Chong, and Bai Yan together, and everyone gathered together to drink and eat meat, so happy.

When night fell, the Tengu cavalry who were monitoring the alliance army around also withdrew, and they did not see the scene of the Zerg fighting weirdness.

On the first day of the alliance army's arrival, the Tengu tribe deliberately forgot about it. If they hadn't taken the initiative to find a place, their current situation would have been even more difficult, and they might have been in danger of being wiped out.

It was really incomprehensible that the Tengu tribe wasted reinforcements like this.

Wu Qing still had too little information to obtain, and many things could not be correctly estimated and judged. Niu Kun's arrival tonight just gave him the opportunity to obtain intelligence from the war zone.

"Lord Niu Kun, what is the current situation on the battlefield? Have you participated in the battle?"

After three rounds of wine, Meng asked Niu Kun.

"We haven't participated in the battle yet, and the situation we can understand here is very limited!"

"I only know that the scouts and vanguards of both sides have fought many times!"

"Both sides have also formed assault troops to specifically intercept each other's food routes. The two sides have been fighting back and forth, and the battle is very lively!"

"Our current supplies are so few, and this has a lot to do with it!"

Niu Kun briefly talked about what he knew.

"Is there a large-scale confrontation between the two armies?"

Meng continued to ask.

"There was an incident yesterday. We all went to the battlefield and entered the battle formation. I thought the war was about to start, but I didn't expect that both sides just created momentum and didn't fight!"

"I estimate that the war will be in these two days. If we don't fight, so many troops gathered here, and the food supply alone will be a big problem!"

"I feel that we will definitely not be able to hold on!"

"..."

In the question and answer between Meng and Niu Kun, Wu Qing obtained a lot of much-needed intelligence.

With the support of this intelligence, sometimes we will not be so passive.

The war zone at night is also very quiet. With the strange escort, neither side has the conditions for large-scale night attacks, and it is relatively safe at night.

When the night is quiet and the banquet is over, Wu Qing's consciousness returns to the body, and he begins to arrange the affairs of the Zerg territory and continue to accumulate troops.

Sending 50,000 troops is not the end. In Wu Qing's view, as long as this battle is not over, he will not withdraw his troops.

No matter in what way or what identity, the Zerg must participate in this war throughout the whole process!

This is an opportunity for the leapfrog development of the Zerg, which must not be missed!

The Zerg also wants to make a name for themselves on this battlefield to protect the development of the alliance.

The Zerg territory has large-scale resource exploitation in the underground space of the mountain, which ensures the steady increase in the number of puppies. At this time, the Zerg territory has gathered a lot of puppies.

Tomorrow morning, these puppies will go to the vicinity of the war zone to lurk. No matter what the situation is tomorrow, the Zerg will look for opportunities to fight and take the initiative to start a war.

...

One night passed.

The territory where the alliance army borrowed the Niu army to station was finally bustling.

The Tengu general who met Wu Qing yesterday brought some supplies.

When the two sides met, they all had cold faces, without even basic etiquette, and there was nothing to say.

"Your placement was delayed yesterday due to an emergency military situation."

"You can negotiate and find a place to stay by yourself, which is great!"

"You will stay here in the future."

"I have sent you a batch of supplies now. After breakfast, you will have combat missions. Try to be as fast as possible!"

"The army you brought this time seems to be quite strong. It just so happens that the assault troops yesterday suffered some losses, so you will make up for it!"

"I will leave a guide for you. Your mission is to attack the supply channel of the evil god camp according to the guide's instructions!"

"This is a formal combat order!"

The general of the Tengu tribe did not give anyone a chance to speak. He spoke all the way, then took out a formal order letter like an envelope and threw it directly to Meng.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content later!

Meng grabbed the order letter, did not read it or say anything, and the atmosphere was a little awkward.

The general of the Tengu tribe frowned and said to a Tengu cavalryman beside him: "You stay as a guide! If you can't complete the task today, you don't have to come back!"

After that, he turned around and led his people away, leaving only the Tengu cavalry guide with a complicated look.

Wu Qing was observing the general of the Tengu tribe throughout the whole process. He found that the arrogance in the bones of the general of the Tengu tribe made him not take the alliance army seriously at all.

On the surface, the 20,000 troops sent by the alliance are indeed not worth mentioning in terms of quantity. There are several 20,000 troops of various tribes stationed around here.

The role of 20,000 troops on such a battlefield is very limited, and it is not worth the attention of the Tengu tribe leaders at all.

Wu Qing guessed that the Tengu clan's interference in the formation of the alliance might just be the personal intention of a certain high-ranking member of the Tengu clan.

This high-ranking member of the Tengu clan might have accidentally learned that the independent territories within the jurisdiction were going to unite and cause trouble, and thought that this was a bad sign, so he casually issued an order to destroy the alliance.

The person who actually executed this order might not have understood the real intention of the high-ranking member.

From the perspective of the entire Tengu clan, such a small alliance of independent territories would not be a big deal and would be insignificant.

If this is the case, then it makes sense why the alliance army would be treated like this.

In the eyes of the Tengu clan, the alliance army has now become an uneasy thorn, and now, a mission to send death has been sent over immediately.
